```{r}
stem_clusters <- c("7", "8")
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 %in% stem_clusters & Phase == "G1")%>% 
  SCTransform(assay = "RNA") %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT") %>% 
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30) %>%
   FindClusters(resolution = c(0.5,0.9)) %>%
   RunUMAP(dims = 1:30,
           reduction.name = "umap.pca")
rna_counts <- GetAssayData(srt_sub, "RNA", layer = "counts")
gene_detection <- Matrix::rowSums(rna_counts>=1)

rna_counts[rna_counts>=1] <- 1
var_genes <- VariableFeatures(srt_sub,nfeatures = 3000)
#var_genes <-  Signac::FindTopFeatures(mat, min.cutoff = 'q0') %>% rownames()%>% head(300)

mat <- Signac::RunTFIDF(object = rna_counts[var_genes,],
                        method = 1)
#top_var <-  Signac::FindTopFeatures(mat, min.cutoff = 'q0')

srt_sub[["lsi_bin"]] <- Signac::RunSVD(mat[var_genes,])
srt_sub <- RunUMAP(srt_sub, reduction = "lsi_bin",dims = 2:30,reduction.name = "umap.lsi")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(srt_sub,
        reduction = "lsi_bin",
        group.by = "sample.name", 
        split.by = "sample.name",
        dims = c(2,3))
```

```{r}
srt_sub[["lsi_bin"]]@cell.embeddings %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(grp = srt_sub$sample.name[rownames(.)]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(LSI_8, color=grp))+
  geom_density()

```

```{r}
stem_clusters <- c("1")
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 %in% stem_clusters)%>% 
  SCTransform(assay = "RNA",
              vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
              residual.features = setdiff(rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc), unlist(proc_params$exclude_reporters))) %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT") %>% 
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:30) %>%
   FindClusters(resolution = c(0.5,0.9)) %>%
   RunUMAP(dims = 1:30,
           reduction.name = "umap.pca")


```
